trusted_controller.state_root_acl: Only AshAtlasCoordinatedReleaseRunner, SYSTEM, and local Administrators may read or write

batch_admission.source_data: controller resolves registered clean worktrees and exact origin refs before canonical admission; Git bundles are passed to the uncredentialed VM

mobile.bootstrap_contract: dispatches the private control workflow with the game source SHA as data, the immutable control ref/SHA, and the private tooling SHA; polls exact control runs, downloads one result artifact, and materializes the seed locally with the canonical bootstrap helper

bootstrap_contract.mobile_seed: controller invokes both mobile children with the pinned generation and source SHA
bootstrap_contract.manifest_path: derived only under state_root; never accepted from workflow input
bootstrap_contract.receipt_path: derived only under state_root; never accepted from workflow input
bootstrap_contract.resume_schedule: controller-owned bounded schedule or webhook; only active operations are resumed
bootstrap_contract.post_health_evidence_input: server_evidence_base64 and server_evidence_sha256 carry the authenticated envelope from the local Windows server_evidence_file to the Mac durable handoff root
bootstrap_contract.post_health_evidence_hash_input: the envelope carries hmac_sha256 and receipt_sha256; the Windows transport journals both the canonical receipt hash and exact UTF-8 transport hash
bootstrap_contract.post_health_receipt: the result artifact is receipt-only; the exact seed remains durable from the initial child operation
